args.text: CREATE TABLE L (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE N (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_N PRIMARY KEY, b BYTE, i SHORT, l LONG, s SINGLE, d DOUBLE, c CURRENCY, dt DATETIME, t TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE NS (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NS PRIMARY KEY, v LONG)
CREATE TABLE E (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_E PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE NB (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NB PRIMARY KEY, v BIGINT)
CREATE TABLE AG (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_AG PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE TX (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TX PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE TXC (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TXC PRIMARY KEY, t TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE ND (id INTEGER CONSTRAINT PK_ND PRIMARY KEY, x DECIMAL(18,4))
INSERT INTO ND (id, x) VALUES (2, Null)
SELECT id, x FROM ND ORDER BY id
SELECT id, v FROM NB ORDER BY id
SELECT (SELECT Count(*) FROM N) AS n, (SELECT Count(*) FROM AG) AS ag, (SELECT Count(*) FROM TXC) AS txc FROM L WHERE id = 1
